resourceSelection.scope: Initial observer launch manifest contained only ordinary binary. Isolated ordinary wallets are captured by basename; the renamed sealed compact market-wallet digest was omitted. Report sampled ordinary-wallet RSS only; no reconstructed or claimed complete prover memory comparison.

scope: one successful real thin Book fill per variant, same owned QA instances, users, semantic call workload, machine and two Rayon threads. Sequential starting balances/nonces differ; actual U124 carry/borrow writes and fee deltas are exposed, not credited to caching. Both early setups include preserved development/restart pauses; two first candidate outer timings are unavailable. Report stages separately. Cold/warm ordinary clients differ in retained immutable circuits. RPC jitter and sequential sample order prevent a steady-state TPS or statistically established general speedup claim. First baseline preparation overlaps build/test activity; commit, settlement and payout run without builds. Signed ordinary signature/endcap phase includes SDK RPC and recursion, not pure CPU. RSS is sampled ordinary-wallet process sum including idle residents and shared pages; sealed compact driver was omitted from the initial observer filter. No complete prover RSS comparison, true peak or host total is available.
